item.title: Government considering ban on ‘virginity testing’
item.description: Family and sexual violence prevention minister Karen Chhour has made a formal request to the minister of justice seeking legislative changes to outlaw the invasive pseudoscientific practice of virginity testing. Justice minister Paul Goldsmith says he’ll be seeking advice on whether New Zealand should ban virginity testing, a pseudoscientific cultural practice the World Health Organisation has labelled a human rights violation.
